title: As for Me and My House

parts.label: Chorus
lines: As for me and my house we will serve the LORD
As for me and my house we will serve the LORD
Choose for yourselves who you will serve
But we will serve the LORD,
we will serve the LORD,
we will serve the LORD

parts.label: Verse 1
lines: Keep your father’s commands
They will guide you when you walk
And the teachings of your mother
When you’re awake they will talk
Bind them, tie them, write them, teach them, keep them…
They’re the way to life

parts.label: Verse 2
lines: With diligence and faith
In sincerity and truth
Remember your creator
In the days of your youth
Bind them, tie them, write them, teach them, keep them…
They’re the way to life

parts.label: Verse 3
lines: Keeping these words
Will be a witness for the world
That God’s hand is mighty
That there’s light in His words
Bind them, tie them, write them, teach them, keep them…

parts.label: Ending
lines: Fear the LORD for ever
Serve the LORD
Serve the LORD
We’ll serve the LORD

parts.label: Verse
lines: For as high as the heavens
are above the earth,
so great is His steadfast love
towards those who fear Him; (those who fear Him)
as far as the east is from the west,
so far does He remove
our transgressions… (He removes them) from us.

parts.label: Chorus
lines: As a father shows compassion
to his children, so the LORD
shows compassion to those who fear Him.
For He knows our frame;
He remembers we are dust.

title: God Made Every Part of Us
If We Say We Have No Sin

parts.label: Verse 1
lines: If we say we have no sin,
we deceive, deceive ourselves,
and the truth is not in us.
No, the truth is not in us.

parts.label: Verse 2
lines: If we confess, confess our sins,
He is faithful, faithful and just
to forgive us our sins
and to cleanse us from all,
from all unrighteousness.
1 John 1, 8 and 9

title: My God Is a Good God

parts.label: Verse 1
lines: Rejoice in the Lord always,
and again I say, rejoice.
Rejoice in the Lord always,
and again I say, rejoice.
Rejoice! Rejoice! And again I say, rejoice.

parts.label: Verse 2
lines: Pray to the Lord always,
and again I say to pray.
Pray to the Lord always,
and again I say to pray.
To pray! To pray! And again I say to pray.

parts.label: Verse 3
lines: Give thanks to the Lord always,
and again I say, give thanks.
Give thanks to the Lord always,
and again I say, give thanks.
Give thanks! Give thanks! And again I say, give thanks.

parts.label: Round
lines: Sing all three verses together as a round

title: Standing in the Need of Prayer

parts.label: Chorus
lines: It’s me, it’s me, it’s me, O Lord,
standing in the need of prayer.
It’s me, it’s me, it’s me, O Lord,
standing in the need of prayer.

parts.label: Verse 1
lines: Not my brother, not my sister,
but it’s me, O Lord,
standing in the need of prayer.
Not my brother, not my sister,
but it’s me, O Lord,
standing in the need of prayer.

parts.label: Verse 2
lines: Not my mother, not my father,
but it’s me, O Lord,
standing in the need of prayer.
Not my mother, not my father,
but it’s me, O Lord,
standing in the need of prayer.

parts.label: Verse 3
lines: Not the stranger, not my neighbour,
but it’s me, O Lord,
standing in the need of prayer.
Not the stranger, not my neighbour,
but it’s me, O Lord,
standing in the need of prayer.

title: The Wise Man Built His House upon the Rock
